title: 第271章 走是不可能走的
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“麻烦？”

张剑停下脚步，眉头微挑，转过身看着福尔卡。

福尔卡往前走了两步，凑到张剑跟前，压低了嗓音。

“你悄悄跟我说。”

“你小子是不是把雅利安给绑了？”

这话一出，站在张剑侧后方的苏莱曼身子猛地一紧。

他右脚不动声色地向后撤了半步。

整个人瞬间绷紧，呈现出一种随时可以暴起发力的战术姿态。

右手更是已经下意识地摸向了后腰的枪柄。

张剑察觉到了苏莱曼的动作，背在身后的手冲他轻轻摆了两下，示意他放松。

转过头，张剑神色如常地看着福尔卡，淡笑出声。

“少校，这话可不能乱说。”

张剑摊开双手，一脸无辜。

“我们可是正经做进出口生意的，大家都是遵纪守法的好民众。”

福尔卡听完这话，脸皮微微抽了抽，恨不得直接一脚踹过去。

“你跟我扯这些？”

福尔卡指了指周围高耸的围墙，又指了指旁边眼神不善的苏莱曼。

“遵纪守法？”

“你这院子里的人，有一个算一个，哪个手里没几条人命？”

“行了，别在这跟我打马虎眼。”

福尔卡烦躁地挥了挥手。

“走，先去你办公室，这事儿在外面不好说。”

张剑点了点头，冲苏莱曼使了个眼色，转身领着福尔卡往厂房里走去。

进了办公室，张剑指了指沙发，自己则走到茶水台前，慢条斯理地烧水泡茶。

“少校，尝尝我这儿的红茶，刚从艾哈里德将军那弄来的好货。”

福尔卡哪有心思喝茶，一屁股坐在沙发上。

“张，别拿艾哈里德将军压我。”

“你这次动静搞得太大了。”

“警察局局长刚才亲自给我打电话，求我帮忙协助调查。”

张剑端着两杯茶走过来，递给福尔卡一杯，自己端着另一杯坐在对面。

“警察局查案子，怎么查到边防营头上了？”

“还不是因为你！”

福尔卡没好气的把茶杯放在茶几上，溅出几滴茶水。

“雅利安在家里被绑架，绑架他的人不仅破坏了周边摄像头，还来了一次极限逃生。”

"Trouble?"

Zhang Jian stopped, raised his eyebrows slightly, turned around and looked at Fulka.

Fulka took two steps forward, approached Zhang Jian, and lowered his voice.

"Tell me quietly."

"Did your kid tie up Aryan?"

As soon as these words came out, Suleiman, who was standing behind Zhang Jian, tensed up suddenly.

He calmly took half a step back with his right foot.

His whole body tensed up in an instant, showing a tactical posture ready to unleash force at any time.

His right hand had already subconsciously touched the handle of the gun on his lower back.

Zhang Jian noticed Suleiman's movements and gently waved his hand behind his back twice to signal him to relax.

Turning his head, Zhang Jian looked at Fulka with a normal expression and smiled lightly.

"Major, don't say this nonsense."

Zhang Jian spread his hands with an innocent look on his face.

"We are serious about import and export business, and we are all good people who abide by the law."

After hearing this, Fulka's face twitched slightly, and he wished he could just kick him.

"Are you talking to me about this?"

Fulka pointed at the towering walls around him, and then at Suleiman who looked at him with an unkind look.

"Abiding by the law?"

"Every one of you in the yard doesn't have a few lives in your hands?"

"Okay, don't play tricks on me here."

Fulka waved his hand irritably.

"Let's go to your office first. It's hard to talk about this outside."

Zhang Jian nodded, winked at Suleiman, turned around and led Fulka towards the factory.

After entering the office, Zhang Jian pointed to the sofa, then walked to the tea table and slowly boiled water to make tea.

"Major, try the black tea I have here. I just got the good stuff from General Alharid."

Fulka had no intention of drinking tea and sat down on the sofa.

"Zhang, don't use General Ahrid to pressure me."

"You made too much noise this time."

"The police chief just called me personally and asked me to help with the investigation."

Zhang Jian came over with two cups of tea, handed one to Fulka, and sat across from him with the other cup.

"How did the police investigation lead to the border guard camp?"

"It's not because of you!"

Fulka put the tea cup on the coffee table angrily, spilling a few drops of tea.

"Aryan was kidnapped at home. His kidnapper not only destroyed the surrounding cameras, but also made an extreme escape."
